title: Remove telemetry_layer helper (breaking API cleanup)
description: Prefer hard removal of telemetry_layer helper over deprecation so the public API converges on one canonical construction path (TelemetryLayer::new(config).build()) without carrying long-tail compatibility surface and ambiguous examples.
notes:
Why removal over deprecation:
- Removes duplicate entry points and avoids mixed guidance in docs/rustdoc.
- Keeps maintenance burden lower by eliminating compatibility shims and deprecation churn.
- Aligns migration messaging around a single final API shape instead of transitional wording.

Concrete targets:
- src/layer.rs: remove telemetry_layer helper and any direct call sites/tests tied only to helper existence.
- src/lib.rs: drop root re-export of telemetry_layer and keep canonical builder/extension exports.
- README/rustdoc/tests: replace helper usage with TelemetryLayer::new(config).build() and/or RouterTelemetryExt patterns; update assertions expected from API surface changes.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] telemetry_layer no longer exists in public API or internal helper surface.
- [ ] src/lib.rs exports no telemetry_layer symbol.
- [ ] README and rustdoc examples contain no telemetry_layer usage.
- [ ] Affected tests are updated for removed symbol and pass against final API shape.
- [ ] Release/migration notes capture the breaking change and replacement path.

Non-goals:
- Introducing new telemetry behavior or changing span semantic conventions.
- Refactoring unrelated tracing initialization/config APIs.
- Broad README tutorial expansion beyond migration/usage correctness.

Priority rationale:
- Recommended P1 because this is an API-shape decision that unblocks accurate docs/migration wording and prevents further churn on soon-to-be-removed patterns.
close_reason: Removed telemetry_layer helper and crate-root re-export; aligned internal docs/agent guidance to canonical TelemetryLayer::new(config).build() path; quality gates pass.
